name: Marabá
registryAssessment: Marabá's official municipal SDU service description evidences a local Cadastro Multifinalitário with georeferenced urban information and an updated cadastral city plan; the official municipal IPTU portal exposes Cadastro Imobiliário/Inscrição lookup. This establishes local registry/cadastre custody, not an open parcel-geometry adapter.

queries.query: Marabá Brazil official cadastral parcel map cadastro imobiliário GIS Prefeitura
queries.result: Found the official Marabá municipal site, official municipal online services/IPTU portal, and an official municipal SDU cadastral-procedure document. No public parcel geometry API or map viewer was found.

queries.query: Marabá cadastro imobiliário mapa lotes planta cadastral Prefeitura SDU geoprocessamento
queries.result: Found the official SDU description of Cadastro Multifinalitário and planta cadastral responsibilities, plus the municipal IPTU/Cadastro Imobiliário portal. The public portal requires an inscription/captcha-style visual code and did not expose parcel geometry or a safe schema.

sourceEvidence.operator: Prefeitura Municipal de Marabá, Superintendência de Desenvolvimento Urbano (SDU)
sourceEvidence.scope: Official service description stating SDU coordinates implementation, use, and updating of the georeferenced Cadastro Multifinalitário for urban Marabá, including the updated cadastral city plan and parceling/subdivision procedures.

sourceEvidence.operator: Prefeitura Municipal de Marabá / municipal tax portal
sourceEvidence.scope: Official public tax service with Cadastro Imobiliário ou Inscrição lookup for imóvel/IPTU.
Municipal law assigning SDU the georeferenced Cadastro Multifinalitário, cadastral plan, and subdivision/remembramento functions.

sourceEvidence.operator: Tribunal de Contas dos Municípios do Pará / Prefeitura de Marabá procurement record
sourceEvidence.scope: 2024 procurement material describing planned GIS, urban cadastral updating, orthophotos, and cadastral-lot database work; not evidence of an accessible current parcel API.
